text.ms:
1. (1) Perintah ini bolehlah dinamakan Perintah Jalan Persekutuan

(Lebuh Raya Pintas Selat Klang Utara Baru) 2014.

 (2) Perintah ini mula berkuat kuasa pada 23 Disember 2014.

Perisytiharan jalan sebagai jalan Persekutuan

2. (1) Jalan persimpangan bertingkat dan jambatan yang membentuk

Lebuh Raya Pintas Selat Klang Utara Baru yang bermula di koordinat U 339212.275,

T 386316.274 Grid Rectified Skew Orthomorphic (RSO) Geosentrik (GDM2000) yang

menghala berterusan ke arah utara dan kemudian ke barat melalui Persimpangan

Bertingkat Meru, Persimpangan Bertingkat Kapar, Persimpangan Bertingkat Bandar

Sultan Sulaiman dan Persimpangan Bertingkat Pelabuhan Utara dan berakhir

di koordinat U 333849.847, T 375142.069 Grid RSO Geosentrik (GDM2000), iaitu suatu

jarak sepanjang 17.5 kilometer diisytiharkan sebagai jalan Persekutuan.

(2) Jalan yang diisytiharkan sebagai jalan Persekutuan di bawah

subperenggan (1) ditunjukkan dalam peta dalam Jadual.

Pembatalan

3. Perintah Jalan Persekutuan (Lebuhraya Pintas Selat Klang Utara Baru) 2002

[P.U. (A) 192/2002] dibatalkan.

JADUAL

[Subperenggan 2(2)]

PETA LEBUH RAYA PINTAS SELAT KLANG UTARA BARU

Dibuat 18 Disember 2014

[KKR/PUU/110-1/7/28; PN(PU2)391/XXIX]

DATO' SRI HAJI FADILLAH BIN HAJI YUSOF

Menteri Kerja Raya

[Akan dibentangkan di Dewan Rakyat menurut seksyen 4 Akta Jalan Persekutuan 1959]

FEDERAL ROADS ACT 1959

FEDERAL ROADS

(NEW NORTH KLANG STRAITS BYPASS EXPRESSWAY) ORDER 2014

IN exercise of the powers conferred by section 3 of the Federal Roads Act 1959

[Act 376], the Minister, after consultation with the State Government of Selangor,

makes the following order:

Citation and commencement

1. (1) This order may be cited as the Federal Roads (New North Klang Straits

Bypass Expressway) Order 2014.

 (2) This Order comes into operation on 23 December 2014.

Declaration of road to be Federal road

2. (1) The road interchanges and bridges which forms the New North Klang

Straits Bypass Expressway commencing at coordinates N 339212.275, E 386316.274

Rectified Skew Orthomorphic (RSO) Geocentric (GDM2000) Grid proceeding in

a continuous north then westerly direction through the Meru Interchange,

Kapar Interchange, Bandar Sultan Sulaiman Interchange and Pelabuhan Utara

Interchange and ending at coordinates N 333849.847, E 375142.069 RSO Geocentric

(GDM2000) Grid, being a distance of 17.5 kilometres is declared to be a Federal road.

(2) The road declared to be a Federal road under subparagraph (1) is shown

on the map in the Schedule.

Revocation

3. The Federal Roads (New North Klang Straits Bypass Expressway) Order 2002

[P.U. (A) 192/2002] is revoked.

SCHEDULE

[Subparagraph 2(2)]
